name: Glitch / datamosh / VHS
look: broken codec blocks, RGB split, pixel smears, tracking noise, scan tears.

fits.notes: AI, security, music, gaming, "something broke" stories, bold challenger. Overused as "tech" shorthand

products: reliability brands unless the glitch is the story

when_not: Overused as "tech" shorthand; avoid for reliability brands unless the glitch is the story.

type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: mono or grotesk; cyan/magenta/black; white timecode.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: brand colour replaces cyan or magenta in the split; black and white around
brand_lock.type_role: mono or grotesk; white timecode; brand face for the claim, never glitched past legibility
brand_lock.world_changes: the film breaks and reforms around the product
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

hints: datamosh smear between scenes (motion vectors dragged over the next scene)
motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects.role: scene-change datamosh: pass the outgoing frame with setPrev

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: a deliberately broken frame of {subject}: codec block corruption, RGB split, scan tears

animate_with.what: displacement / warp (shader fed by noise or depth)

codex_assets.r1_note: no need; stills can be glitched as plates if you want custom "broken" frames.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.recipe: `library/motion/glitch/glitch-datamosh.md`; implement in GLSL: block-hash displacement + chroma split, accumulation buffer for smear (Three.js with render targets, seek-safe via seeded hashes on `floor(t*fps)`). Apple-keynote-clean otherwise.

examples.title: "The Glitch" (BBDO, Alzheimer Forschung Initiative, datamosh transitions)

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.
